inputs.text: This is what happens when sanctuary politics put ideology ahead of public safety. New York City released an illegal immigrant gang member despite the danger he posed, and ICE had to step in. Local officials who obstruct federal enforcement are making ordinary families live with the consequences. A government’s first responsibility is to protect its citizens and uphold the law—not excuse decisions that put public safety at risk.
